# ChatGPT Web Harness v1.4.0

This release adds the Windows desktop client and the Skill/plugin lifecycle required for installing, disabling, and removing reviewed local extensions without bundling app-level Skills.

Highlights:

- Electron setup, portable, and x64 ZIP packaging for the local MCP server and Secure MCP Tunnel.
- Portable per-launch isolation with payload-manifest validation and fail-closed startup.
- Embedded Electron Node forwarding for child processes on machines without system Node.
- v2 Skill registry, deterministic resolver/aliases, atomic install metadata, enable/disable/uninstall, Admin API routes, and MCP lifecycle tools.
- Local directory and ZIP Skill installation with traversal, symbolic-link, and expansion safeguards; package scripts are never executed.
- `slim` profile updated to 30 tools, including `install_skill`, `uninstall_skill`, and `set_skill_enabled`.

The release package contains no app-level preinstalled Skills. Existing ChatGPT custom MCP apps must be rescanned/re-published to receive the three new lifecycle tools.
